# Airtop

Airtop provides cloud browsers and AI-powered web automation for navigating sites, interacting with pages, extracting data, and running reusable browser workflows.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/airtop/.

## Actions

- **Click Element**: Use Airtop AI to locate an element from a natural-language description and click it.
- **Close Window**: Close one browser window without terminating its Airtop session.
- **Create Session**: Create an Airtop browser session and wait until it is running.
- **Create Window**: Create a browser window in a running Airtop session and load an initial URL.
- **List Sessions** (read-only): List Airtop browser sessions, optionally filtering by IDs or status.
- **List Windows** (read-only): List all browser windows in a running Airtop session, including their IDs, current URLs, and titles when available.
- **Navigate Window**: Navigate an existing Airtop browser window to a new URL and optionally wait for page loading.
- **Query Page** (read-only): Ask Airtop AI a question about a page or extract structured page content.
- **Terminate Session**: Terminate an Airtop session and all of its windows.
- **Type Text**: Use Airtop AI to locate an input and type text into it.
